headline: PHI @ SDP matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 3.34 at SDP 2.49, with a projected total of 5.83. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SDP: PHI moved -1.82 runs while SDP moved -0.93, changing the projected margin by -0.89 runs. The projected total fell -2.75, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +13.8%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Cristopher Sánchez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Brandon Marsh, Fernando Tatis Jr., Alec Bohm, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adolis García, Justin Crawford because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
